section_header: W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION — COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL
ocr_text:
MT1–17

W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION – COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

(g) Using 2 screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the snap ring of
No. 2 shaft.

E9793                                                202525

(h) Remove the No. 2 shift fork and shaft.

UP0032

(i) Using a magnetic finger, remove the No.3 interlock pin.
INSTALLATION HINT: Apply MP grease to the No.3 interlock
pin.

WM0310 WM0033                                      202524

(j) Using a pin punch and hammer, drive out the No. 3 fork shaft
pin.

UP0034

(k) Using a hexagon wrench, remove the plug.
Torque: 25 N·m (250 kgf·cm, 18 ft·lbf)
INSTALLATION HINT: Apply sealant to the plug.
Sealant:
    Part No.08833–00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE 242
    or equivalent

000849
